testName: E-Bikes: Custom Electric Bike Assembly & Real-time MSRP Calculation
steps:
1. Open E-Bikes App from App Launcher
2. Navigate to "Bike Customizer" tab
3. Select Base Model "Aero Urban Cruiser" (Base MSRP: $1,899.00)
4. In Motor selection, choose "750W Performance Hub (+ $250.00)"
5. In Battery selection, choose "625Wh Extended Range (+ $300.00)"
6. In Shifter selection, choose "Shimano Deore 10-Speed (+ $120.00)"
7. Verify live Total MSRP updates dynamically to "$2,569.00"
8. Click "Save Configuration" button
9. Verify custom product configuration record is generated with serialized assembly code
